critical_code_review_comments: InventoryIncidentsTab.jsx (286 lines) is approaching the 300-line comfort threshold — consider extracting the row renderer and timeline panel into subcomponents for maintainability.

The successor note branch (lines 211-215) only shows when related.length <= 1, but if a predecessor_id exists we would normally expect its chain to be in relatedByKey; verify this is still reachable or remove dead branch.

AdminProducts.remove() depends on backend 409 detail for the toast — the error path is working but note it leaks server-side wording directly; acceptable here since UX text is already Spanish and user-facing.
